title: 3 AI Tools That Build Your Video in 1 Line
tldr: These 3 tools turn one prompt into a finished video.
No editing experience needed — just copy the prompt and go.

steps.title: Open Runway and paste the prompt below
steps.detail: Use the free tier to start

snippets.label: Prompt template
snippets.code: A cinematic shot of <subject>, golden hour, 4k

tips: Keep prompts under 20 words for the cleanest results.
Always preview a short clip before rendering the full video.
mistakes: Don't skip setting the aspect ratio before you generate.
Don't forget to add your own voice track before exporting.
